title: 大阪杯の後に・太陽、揺るがず

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober completely loses herself in her running and comes in first. However, being exposed to Air Groove's intimidating presence still makes her shake with fear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She can't help but feel frustrated, recognizing she's still far from becoming like Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Immediately after returning to the waiting room, she declares she wants to race in the Takarazuka Kinen and become like Air Groove. Her desperation triggers a sense of unease in me again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, I can't put how I feel into words, so we simply set the Takarazuka Kinen as her next goal.
